text:
alex_g: quick follow-up from today's arch sync — sketching a 'modular contract deprecation ladder' we discussed so teams can plan breaking changes with minimal churn. TL;DR: 3 stages (compat, soft-deprecate, hard-deprecate) + migration helpers.
priya_m: can you outline what each stage legally guarantees? esp compatibility window length and rollback options.
alex_g: short version:
- compat: old+new run in parallel, no behavioral changes, no SW mandatory changes for callers
- soft-deprecate: new contract is preferred; older paths emit warnings and telemetry; clients should migrate within X weeks
- hard-deprecate: old contract removed; fallback policy might route to slower compat tier for a short time
ben_r: biggest ask from infra: automated flagging + a small client shim to ease migration. I can own a migration-helper lib.
sarah_p: product concern — we need clear customer-facing comms. suggested cadence: announce -> 1 month soft-deprecate -> 2 months hard-deprecate. thoughts?
kevin_o: ops: also need observability signals and SLO rollback knobs. propose adding a new SLO-exemption tag during soft-deprecate and an alert if migration stalls >30% customers.
ben_r: proof-of-concept shim idea:
```
// migration-helper v0.1
const shim = loadShim('contract-v2');
shim.warnOn(oldCall, 'contract-v2 available');
shim.fallbackTo(oldCall, { rateLimit: 0.1 });
```
alex_g: love that. patch proposal: include shim + server-side telemetry + deprecation header in responses.
priya_m: one more: How do we handle schema changes for streaming responses / KV cache keys? that's a high-risk area.
kevin_o: for KV cache keys: introduce key-version prefix and provide a migration job to backfill critical prefixes. Streaming: require idempotent framing + dual-compat stream mode during compat phase.
arch-bot: New doc created: https://rwd-internal/arch/modular-contract-deprecation-ladder (internal) :bookmark:
alex_g: next steps I propose:
- ben to prototype shim + PR for migration-helper
- infra to add telemetry hooks + deprecation header
- docs to draft customer comms + migration guide
- set internal schedule (announce + soft + hard) and register with release calendar
sarah_p: approved. I'll coordinate comms and legal review.
ben_r: will drop an initial PR by EOD Fri and add a checklist.
kevin_o: I'll add alerts and a runbook entry. :white_check_mark:
alex_g: cool — if no objections by EOD tomorrow, I'll send RFC follow-up with schedule and owners.
